concerns.text: FR-002 requires quantization at a minimal depth of 4 bits and at 8, 10, 12, 14, 16 bits. The plan implements depths 1, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16 but omits the required 4‑bit depth, leaving the functional requirement partially unaddressed.

FR-015 mandates a sensitivity analysis to verify that quantization‑induced error can be approximated as the difference between total error and instrumental error (≤ 5 % deviation). The current plan and coverage map do not mention any task performing this analysis, so the requirement is unbacked.
